column1: # Columns: variant|default|why. Simplified characters, as the pair table keys words.
# A word with the variant character never gets a higher pair score than the same word with the
# default character, next to the same word or the clause end, and spoken counts do not raise it
# above the default; the lexicon weight still decides.
她|他|he is the unmarked pronoun when nothing in the text says otherwise
它|他|same; 它 for things is chosen when the person picks it
嘛|吗|a question ends in 吗; between words such as 干嘛 and 干吗 the lexicon weight decides
妳|你|你 is the unmarked "you"; 妳 is chosen when the person picks it
